main_theorem: Shifted Co-Poisson Cascade Reduction for Xi_BC on the Burnol/Sonine Carrier

reduction_chain.statement: On u=Cg with g legal and G=ghat, M(B_{l,a} Cg)=T_a P_infty M_zeta(m_l G)-T_a P_infty M_{m_l} P_infty M_zeta G.
The full Cg zeta factorization is equivalent to ZI-COV^{CP}_{l,a}: P_infty M_zeta G=M_zeta A_infty G and T_a P_infty M_zeta H=M_zeta A_{T,a}H, with alpha=A_{T,a}(m_l(G-A_infty G)).
ZI-COV(i) holds on the zero-free-output subclass via A_infty^Omega=M_{1/zeta} P_infty M_zeta; full-carrier ZI-COV(i) is not target-equivalent to RH under inherited records.
Closure of full ZI-COV reduces to deciding L_{rho,k}(G)=<P_infty M_zeta G,y_{rho,k}>=<M_zeta G,P_infty y_{rho,k}>; five structural routes reduce to L_{rho,k}.
Closing the shifted co-Poisson exact route for Xi_BC reduces, under inherited records, to deciding the matrix-element family {L_{rho,k}} or an equivalent theorem in the same typed carrier.
